Record verification

Verify a result record

Drop a result record here to check its agreed terms, delivery history and buyer decision. No sign-in needed. Your files stay on this device.

Verify record

Use the .json file saved with “Download result record”. The check starts as soon as you add it. A PDF or screenshot is a readable copy and cannot be checked.

ProofTask’s issuer keys are pinned in this verifier, so a ProofTask result record needs nothing else. To check a record from another issuer, add its keys under “Add more evidence”.

Add more evidence (optional)

Only needed for a record from another issuer, or to check against your own copy of the keys. Keys you choose replace the keys in the record.

Download ProofTask’s current issuer keys

How to confirm the issuer keys
  1. Obtain the issuer keys from a source your organization trusts. For ProofTask, open the official trust page separately.
  2. Compare every key ID and full SHA-256 fingerprint below with that trusted source. Also confirm its key status and validity policy.
  3. If a key is new, changed or unexpected, confirm it through your established contact before trusting it.

Open the official trust page

Use fingerprints obtained through your trusted channel. This comparison does not confirm the source for you.

Separate status files selected here replace any status included in the result record, even when this section is closed.

A status check is fresh for five minutes. To check again, ask a party for a new result record or use “Check and export current status” in the workspace. Without fresh status, the signed history can still be checked.

Choose a signed JSON copy you already hold for this agreement. Both histories are checked with the same trusted issuer keys. Comparing copies can reveal conflicting history; it does not prove that no other copies exist.

Use a policy approved by your organization after checking the mandate through an independent channel. The sender’s claims cannot approve themselves. How to establish company authority

What the result record proves and does not prove
  • The agreement text, the delivered file versions and the buyer’s decision are recorded as they were and sealed with ProofTask’s digital signature. Any later change makes verification fail.
  • People are identified by a verified email account. Company identity and authority to act are as the parties stated them, unless the agreement required further checks.
  • Times come from ProofTask’s clock. Only where the record shows a trusted timestamp or a confirmed Bitcoin timestamp has an independent source also dated it.
  • The record does not establish the quality of the work beyond the buyer’s recorded judgment, and it does not show payment.
Verification purpose

I have a result record JSON file

Verification help

If a record includes a trusted timestamp or a Bitcoin timestamp, it is inside the file and checked here, on this device.

To check party signatures, also add the approved participant keys and, if the parties signed before the first delivery, the agreement proofs file.

Three questions before using a record
What was delivered?
Read the agreed scope, submission version and supporting materials.
Who decided, and when?
Read the attributed buyer decision. Check authority separately when your use requires it.
What still needs checking?
Check current status and original files. Acceptance, signature checks and payment are separate facts.

Independent verification

Which format should I keep or share?
PDF · read and present
A readable snapshot for a project folder or payment review. It does not check signatures and will not show later changes.
Result record · check the signed history
Download the result record (JSON). It contains the signed history, issuer keys and any included status check. Open it in the browser verifier, and confirm the issuer keys through a trusted source.
Read-only link · give someone access
A link can expire or be revoked. It shows later changes only when the sender allows updates. Check the displayed status and time before using it for a new decision.

For a lasting archive, keep the PDF, result record and original delivery files together. The result record contains file fingerprints and references, not the original file contents.

Review a delivery and reuse what worked

Looking for your own records? Open My projects and choose the project.
